test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If 14 January 2022 was Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 28 February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is option(1)

In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same date of the previous year.

14 January 2022 = Friday

14 January 2023 = Saturday

14 January 2024 = Sunday

If an ordinary year comes immediately after a leap year, then the day on a certain date of the ordinary year will be 2 days ahead of the same date of the leap year upto February

14 January 2025 = Tuesday

From 14 January 2025 to 28 February 2025 = 45 days (42 + 3)

Number of odd days 
= 3 days

Therefore, 28 February = Friday (3 days ahead from Tuesday)

Hence, the correct answer is Option(1)
